name: cache-clock
description: A one-line band above the prompt: context used, and a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold

onWarning.title: When the cache is about to go cold
onWarning.description: What to do at the warning if you haven't replied. handoff: Claude writes a per-session HANDOFF-<id>.md. compact: the session compacts while the cache is warm, so your next message is a small write. off: just the toast.
